sources.snippet: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. Four key improvements define this release: Compact and Efficient — A lightweight architecture ...

sources.title: kkguku/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Diffusion Model: Add the Unet Loader (GGUF) node and select your downloaded .gguf file. Text Encoder: Add the standard CLIPLoader node, select qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors (or int8), and set type to qwen_image.

sources.title: Is Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored? Filters, License, and the Law
sources.snippet: Official Qwen-Image-2.1 weights have no safety checker; Alibaba-hosted versions filter prompts. The "Uncensored GGUF" is the same model, still non-commercial.
